summary: The diff implements fixes for both REQ-1 and REQ-2. WorkoutLibraryPage was refactored to fetch all exercises once via useGetAllExercises and filter client-side by muscle group (fixing the zero-exercise count bug). useQueries.ts added the useGetAllExercises hook and updated cache invalidation. The backend's Exercise type uses primaryMuscle field consistently. All core acceptance criteria appear addressed.
